title: Moral Hazard in Delegated Bayesian Persuasion
abstract: arXiv:2604.10006v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study delegated Bayesian persuasion: a principal incentivizes an intermediary to design information via outcome-contingent transfers, while the intermediary privately chooses the experiment subject to convex costs. We characterize first-best implementability through a pair of alignment conditions on the principal's and intermediary's payoff indices. A local condition on the support of the target experiment is necessary; a global affine alignment condition is sufficient. We show that the gap between them is non-empty and provide a partial characterization of the intermediate region. When the first-best is unattainable, the principal's problem admits a virtual Bayesian persuasion representation: the second-best experiment maximizes the same concavified objective as the first-best, with the principal's payoff index distorted by a single scalar shadow price that summarizes the entire agency friction. Under entropy costs, moral hazard

translated_title: 委托贝叶斯说服中的道德风险
translated_abstract: 我们研究委托贝叶斯说服问题：委托人通过基于结果的转移支付来激励中介设计信息，而中介在面临凸成本约束的情况下私下选择实验。我们通过委托人与中介收益指数之间的一对对齐（一致性）条件来刻画一阶最优的可实施性。其中，目标实验支撑集上的局部条件是必要的；全局仿射对齐条件是充分的。我们证明这两者之间的差距并非空集，并对中间区域给出了部分刻画。当一阶最优无法实现时，委托人的问题可以用虚拟贝叶斯说服的形式来表示：次优实验最大化与一阶最优相同的凹化目标函数，只是委托人的收益指数被一个标量影子价格所扭曲，该影子价格概括了全部的代理摩擦。在熵成本下，道德风险……
tldr: 该论文研究了委托贝叶斯说服中的道德风险问题，通过一对对齐条件刻画一阶最优的可实施性，并证明当一阶最优不可实现时，次优问题可表示为“虚拟贝叶斯说服”——即仅用一个标量影子价格扭曲委托人的收益指数，便能概括全部代理摩擦。
en_tdlr: This paper studies moral hazard in delegated Bayesian persuasion, characterizes first-best implementability via a pair of alignment conditions, and shows that when the first-best is unattainable, the second-best admits a virtual Bayesian persuasion representation where a single scalar shadow price distorts the principal's payoff index to capture the entire agency friction.
